dashboard.help.title: RADAR LEB
dashboard.help.intro: RADAR LEB is a fun game that combines strategy and luck. The goal is to scan across regions of Lebanon and collect virtual antennas using the radar interface. Every successful scan increases your virtual antenna counter. When you discover six active virtual antennas, you win the prize you have selected — phones, electronics, motorbikes, SUVs, or super cars.
dashboard.help.howToTitle: How to participate and play RADAR LEB
dashboard.help.step1: Download the WISH app on your phone, or use the door-to-door cash pickup service.
dashboard.help.step2: Top up your wallet in USD with at least the minimum amount listed below, then transfer the amount to {phone} and confirm the transfer over WhatsApp with your full name, phone number, and the minimum required amount per prize in the NOTE / REASON field.
dashboard.help.step3: Radar charging takes up to 24 hours.
dashboard.help.step5: Tap SCAN to start detecting virtual antennas across Lebanon.
dashboard.help.step6: Once you discover six active virtual antennas, you win the selected prize.
dashboard.help.notes: Notes: scan from different locations within Lebanon to ensure detection. After radar charging, refunds are not available. Only the prize winner can claim the prize.
dashboard.help.locationText: Use My Location to keep your real-world position active, helping RadarLeb deliver the best antenna-hunting experience around you.
dashboard.help.radarCashText: Radar Cash stores your game balance. Use it to scan, build progress, and play for the prizes you want to win.
